description: Unsigned transactions to buy same-day option tokens from the cheapest offers of a series: exact approval of the USDG, then one buy for each offer taken, each with its cost as the most it may take. Returns the cost, the break-even and what the option pays after the close. The most a buyer can lose is the cost.

max_cost.description: The most to pay in all, USDG (optional), as a decimal string, like "1.5"

options.description: Options to buy (at least 0.001; one option is on one share), as a decimal string, like "1.5"

series_id.description: The series id instead of type and strike (options_0dte and position list them)

strike.description: The strike in dollars, like "165" (options_0dte gives the step)

symbol.description: A stock with same-day options, by its ticker, like NVDA

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: buy_0dte
title: Prepare: buy same-day options
